# Workspace directories and the transfer CLI work end to end on a generic space.
mkdir local
mkdir remote-files
exec sh -c 'printf "[nas]\ntype = alias\nremote = %s\n" "$1" > rclone.conf' sh $WORK/remote-files
chmod 0600 rclone.conf

# A workspace config file in the working directory drives every command.
exec sh -c 'printf "state: %s\nrclone_config: %s\n" "$1" "$2" > drivebridge.yaml' sh $WORK/state $WORK/rclone.conf
chmod 0600 drivebridge.yaml

exec drivebridge space add --space nas --backend generic --remote nas --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
stdout 'Space configured'

# mkdir is idempotent.
exec drivebridge mkdir --space nas --path refs/2026
stdout 'Directory ready'
exec drivebridge mkdir --space nas --path refs/2026
stdout 'Directory ready'

# Upload through the CLI lands inside the directory.
exec sh -c 'printf "payload" > local/a.bin'
exec drivebridge upload --space nas --file a.bin --dir refs/2026 --json
stdout '"status":"queued"'
exists $WORK/remote-files/refs/2026

# The deterministic CLI key makes a retry idempotent, not a duplicate.
exec drivebridge upload --space nas --file a.bin --dir refs/2026 --json
stdout '"status":"queued"'

# ls lists by path once the async upload lands.
exec sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 50); do drivebridge ls --space nas --path refs/2026 --json | grep -q "\"count\":1" && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; exit 1'

# Traversal is rejected.
! exec drivebridge mkdir --space nas --path ../escape
stderr 'path_not_allowed'

# Generic install prints the stdio command without touching secrets.
exec drivebridge install --client generic --json
stdout '"args"'
! stdout 'token'
